name: Arduino Nano V3
description: A compact, breadboard-friendly microcontroller with 14 digital pins, 8 analog inputs, and a Mini-B USB programming port.
realWorldAnalogy: A compact, breadboard-friendly microcontroller with 14 digital pins, 8 analog inputs, and a Mini-B USB programming port.

hazards: Double check pin alignment before pressing into breadboard

wiringGuidance: Press firmly across the center divider of a solderless breadboard so each pin has its own separate tie-point row.
commonMistakes: Plugging the Nano into a single column of breadboard holes, shorting opposite pins.
Selecting Uno instead of Nano in Arduino IDE board selector.

miniExperiment.title: Nano Serial Hello
miniExperiment.circuit: Connect Nano via Mini-USB to computer.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor displays 'Hello from Arduino Nano!' followed by 'Nano online.' every second.
